ns2:section.sectionText: During the week of August 26, this course will meet on Monday August 26 at 7:30 PM CST. There will be no class meeting on Wednesday, August 28. Students who are not able to attend the session on Monday, August 26 should contact Anna Mehl at annamehl@illinois.edu. The course is scheduled to meet on Wednesdays from September 4th throughout the rest of the semester. Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course is intended for CPSC, NRES, AGED degree and non-degree students. FSHN degree students should register in FSHN 440 XM (CRN: 50453). Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
